title: Drupal 9 502 for editors only: a session table outage
lede: A Drupal 9 site started 502ing only for logged-in editors on a Thursday afternoon. Anonymous traffic was fine. The cause was a sessions table that had outgrown ibdata1.
hero_alt: Overhead still life on bone linen: inked MySQL schema, 502 error printout, manila folder, index cards, brass plate, wax seal.
